The bell is clearly visible on the right side, flaring outwards and facing the viewer/right.

The instrument exhibits a uniform golden-yellow metallic finish consistent with lacquered brass.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The valve casings appear cylindrical and show vertical highlights/seams consistent with metal construction.
The edge of the bell shows a distinct thickened rim, characteristic of a rolled wire edge.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The mouthpiece appears to melt directly into the cookie on the left. There is no clear boundary or shadow indicating the metal is resting against the cookie; instead, the textures blend unnaturally.
The cookie fragment beneath/behind the bell lacks structural integrity and appears to be merging with the metal bell. The geometry of the cookie is nonsensical where it meets the trumpet.
The brass texture is overly smooth and uniform, lacking the micro-scratches, dents, or tarnish expected on a real used instrument. It has a plastic-like CGI sheen.
